text:
maya: Idea: run micro-DP cohorts (2w active) but add a prioritization/triage playbook so every piece of feedback maps to an action or experiment. keeps PM backlog tidy.
tony: love it. playbook should have triage fields: severity, reproducible?, owner, ETA, experiment needed?
li: recruitment note keep screener tiny: 1) workload type 2) expected tokens/day 3) privacy class 4) can do quick integration?
sam: perks: priority triage, 2h onboarding, optional co-marketing, and an SLA note around spikes.
meera: success gates: 5+ actionable items per cohort, 60% triaged to milestones or experiments within 2w, 2 integration pilots producing measurable traffic, and no P0 regressions.
legal-anna: language for traces use "redacted traces" + optional DPA. I'll post approved text.
tony: feedback loop: weekly sync, shared Notion pulse + issue template that maps to playbook fields. build a tiny GH workflow to tag triaged items.
li: engineering: can we auto-run smoke evals against golden outputs after each deploy?
sam: yes - runtime will run smoke evals; need prompt set owner. meera will own prompts.
deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance disabled for DP pool during cohort windows.
maya: owners: meera (prompts & eval), sam (ops & facilitation), tony (playbook + GH automations), legal-anna (contracts).
meera: timeline: 1w recruit, 2w active, 1w wrap = 4w. pilot start 21 days out.
maya: will draft playbook doc and share scoop for review.
sam: I'll draft invite copy and landing page tomorrow.
